import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression


def task_func(df, x_column, y_column):
    # Select relevant data and drop missing values
    data = df[[x_column, y_column]].dropna()

    x = data[[x_column]].values
    y = data[y_column].values

    # Create plot
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.scatter(data[x_column], data[y_column])

    # Fit linear regression model
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(x, y)

    # Predict regression line over sorted x values for a clean line plot
    x_sorted_idx = data[x_column].argsort()
    x_sorted = data[x_column].iloc[x_sorted_idx].values.reshape(-1, 1)
    y_pred = model.predict(x_sorted)

    # Overlay regression line in red
    ax.plot(x_sorted, y_pred, color="red")

    return ax
